title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
script:
Disruptive just closed a ten billion dollar fund for its next series of bets.
The firm plans to back at least ten companies with this massive pool of capital.
Disruptive previously invested heavily in the AI chip startup Groq.
They also poured funding into the AI voice generation startup ElevenLabs.
This firm has gained significant attention for its high-profile moves within the AI sector.
These investments aim to capitalize on the rapid expansion of specialized AI tools.
Would you bet ten billion on the future of these AI startups?
